notes.title: Free demo now available!
notes.content:
The demo for the roguelite × puzzle game Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle- is now available on Steam as of Wednesday, September 24, 2025!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3987520/Dialoop__Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

In the demo, you can play the core mode of the game: “Solo Survival”! 

Enjoy the unique randomness of roguelite gameplay and the strategic depth that only puzzles can offer. 



Additionally, a major update planned for October will introduce the online multiplayer mode, “Arena”! 

Look forward to competing with friends and players from around the world in this exciting new mode. 



A video where the developers provide an in-depth explanation of Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle- is also available!
[previewyoutube="XI5mO3qf2CE;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo Release Date Confirmed!
notes.content:
Everyone, thank you for waiting!

The demo release date for Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle- has been set for Thursday, September 24!!At the same time, the Steam demo page is now live.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3987520/Dialoop__Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

In the demo, you can play the core mode of the game: “Solo Puzzle”!
Enjoy the unique strategy and addictive gameplay that only a roguelite × puzzle game can offer.



Additionally, a major update planned for October will add an online multiplayer mode, “Puzzle Together”!
Look forward to competing with friends and players from around the world in this new mode.



Be sure to try the demo and experience the world of roguelite × puzzle!



A video where the developers thoroughly explain Dialoop -Roguelite Puzzle- is also available!
Check it out here: ↓
